contract: ProcessChild.StartConfirmed is mandatory, prompt, safe for concurrent calls, monotonic, and valid after Release.
Public start_confirmed combines positive query evidence with valid primary termination.
Ownership alone does not confirm OS creation. Creation evidence does not confirm target execution or an execution permit.
Successful Release settles pending creation and prevents any future owned child.
Settled cancellation before creation can omit termination. Confirmed creation without termination remains a host cleanup failure.
Failed Release retains ownership and registry quarantine. Returned progress remains immutable.
